timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹155.39 Cr (-4.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹42.32 Cr (+121.0% YoY).
Arvind SmartSpaces recommended a final dividend of ₹2.25 per share, approved a ₹300 Cr debt raise, and a ₹125 Cr investment into an HDFC Capital platform on May 20, 2026.
Arvind SmartSpaces Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 & FY2026 results conference call with analysts/investors on May 21, 2026.
Arvind SmartSpaces reported Q4 FY26 PAT of ₹44 Cr, up 103% YoY, and recommended a final dividend of ₹2.25 per share.
Aura Securities submitted the annual Regulation 31(4) promoter share encumbrance declaration for FY26 on June 3, 2026.
